meta.name: ably-automation
meta.description: Automate Ably tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 通过Rube工具自动化Ably实时消息任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要通过Rube工具自动操作Ably实时消息服务
copy.tagline_en: Automate Ably real-time messaging tasks via Rube tools.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to automate Ably tasks using Rube MCP tools.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 Rube MCP 自动执行 Ably 操作，如管理连接、调用工具等。每次使用前会先搜索最新工具模式，再按步骤执行。
howto.when: 当用户要求执行 Ably 相关任务，如发送消息、管理渠道等时触发。需要先确保 Rube MCP 已连接且 Ably 连接状态为 ACTIVE。

say.text: 帮我通过 Ably 发送一条消息
say.note: Claude 会搜索可用工具并执行发送操作。

say.text: 检查我的 Ably 连接状态
say.note: Claude 会调用连接管理工具返回状态。

say.text: 列出 Ably 工具箱中所有工具
say.note: Claude 会搜索 Ably 操作的工具列表。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can automate Ably operations via Rube MCP, such as managing connections and executing tools. It always searches for current tool schemas first before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user requests Ably-related tasks, like sending messages or managing channels. Requires Rube MCP connected and Ably connection status ACTIVE.

say_en.text: Send a message via Ably for me
say_en.note: Claude will search tools and execute the send operation.
Claude will call the connection management tool.

say_en.text: List all tools in the Ably toolkit
say_en.note: Claude will search for Ably operation tools.
